about: generalbank.drm knowledge for tools/generalbank_pc_build.py: the sections of the developer reference (K12 + HUD generalbank, the base of ring tree 7) that differ from the player's PC patch.000 generalbank, as word programs over sections of the player's own files (pc = PC patch.000 generalbank, tu = Xbox title update TitleUpdate.000 generalbank, tex = tools/tex_convert of a TU texture), each source with its md5; forms id / kp (bytes kept), sw (u32 swap), h (u16-pair swap). No game data is stored here: residual bytes no rule derives yet are inline only when small (values, listed in docs Befund-Wissen-nur-Verweise-1111.md), otherwise in the local knowledge file outside the repository. Script 7 is not recorded: recipe P3 + tools/menu_ring_p14.py (its D1 rewrites the three slot-7 sites). post_ring_sections = new sections appended after the ring (tu_camera: tools/tu_camera_dtp.py rules). Classes: see the tool docstring and docs Befund-Generalbank-PC-Basis-1111.md.
